new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.uniformIndex_map_atom
new_declarations.header:
private theorem uniformIndex_map_atom {β : Type v} (n : Nat)
    (f : Fin (n + 1) → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (PMF.map f (RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex n)) (f i) =
      (((n + 1 : Nat) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹)

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.stepRun_all_equal
new_declarations.header:
theorem stepRun_all_equal (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (x : α)
    (hall : ∀ a ∈ xs, a = x) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    stepRun k xs i =
      if k < xs.length then
        (Sum.inr x, 3 * xs.length + i.val + 6)
      else (Sum.inl (k - xs.length, []), 3 * xs.length + i.val + 6)

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_all_equal_cons
new_declarations.header:
theorem run_all_equal_cons (k : Nat) (x : α) (tail : List α)
    (hall : ∀ a ∈ tail, a = x) :
    run k (x :: tail) =
      PMF.map (fun i : Fin (tail.length + 1) =>
        if k < tail.length + 1 then
          (some x, ([(tail.length + 1, i.val)], 3 * (tail.length + 1) + i.val + 6))
        else (none, ([(tail.length + 1, i.val)], 3 * (tail.length + 1) + i.val + 8)))
        (RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex tail.length)

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_replicate_valid
new_declarations.header:
theorem run_replicate_valid (n k : Nat) (x : α) (hk : k < n + 1) :
    run k (List.replicate (n + 1) x) =
      PMF.map (fun i : Fin (n + 1) =>
        (some x, ([(n + 1, i.val)], 3 * (n + 1) + i.val + 6)))
        (RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex n)

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_all_equal
new_declarations.header:
theorem run_all_equal (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (x : α)
    (hall : ∀ a ∈ xs, a = x) (hk : k < xs.length) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    ∃ i : Nat, i < xs.length ∧
      result = (some x, ([(xs.length, i)], 3 * xs.length + i + 6))

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_all_equal_summary
new_declarations.header:
theorem run_all_equal_summary (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (x : α)
    (hall : ∀ a ∈ xs, a = x) (hk : k < xs.length) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    result.1 = some x ∧ result.2.1.length = 1 ∧ scanVolume result.2.1 = xs.length ∧
      3 * xs.length + 6 ≤ result.2.2 ∧ result.2.2 ≤ 4 * xs.length + 5

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_all_equal_absorbed

    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    activeSize (time + 1) result.2.1 = 0 ∧ residualWork (time + 1) result.2.1 = 0

new_declarations.name: Resources.RandomSelection.run_replicate_scan_lt_quadratic
